items.quote: He took ownership of the partnership with sister agencies on youth services and steered it to completion.
Rendo delivered his share of community engagement on the estate renewal plan reliably.
He championed incident management during the ransomware attack and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He championed the organisational restructuring of the department and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of dashboards tracking service performance metrics.
He set the direction for the migration of core services to the cloud across the public service.
He spearheaded capability building for new hires at the national level.
He set the direction for root cause analysis of recurring service failures across the public service.
He set the direction for presentations to senior management across the public service.
